Pan-servo posts x +-(12.05..17.25), y -25.1..-15.05 (spec 11.25..17.25, -24.6..-17.1): 0.3 off the STS3032 case; DIN 562 slot runs through the post in x, 4.7 wide in y (+-0.3 C slot); +X post: window for the servo plug + front leg 1.5.

Deck (T_paluba) trim r <= 26.6 for B az 26.2..223.8 (spec 16..232) with a C-ear around pin 1 (from its back side): the lug block sweeps B az 28.3..221.7 below the pin tops, 1.0 clearance = 2.08 deg at r 27.6.

The -X end of the deck's back lobe is unscrewed (rests on the +Y wall and the servo top).

F3b: DIN 7991 M2.5x6 countersunk, flush in the ALUMINIUM T_most (no countersunk head in resin anywhere): ISO 7380 heads on top of T_most would sit in the FFC duct / under the gear tips (r 14..20, z -46.2..-44.3). F1 = ISO 7380 M2.5x6 (spec x8: the tip would reach z -75.1, 0.6 into the T_stred boss beyond its insert pilot).

Carrier PCB x -27..28.6 (spec -23..23), F7 at x -25 / 25.8 (spec +-19: x +19 is under the ESP32-S3-Zero); F7 = M2x5 (x6 tip 0.05 from the STS3215 case).  Bosses fused with the cradle wall / stop post 1.

Box closure z -51..-34 (spec -52): 1.2 above the amplifier / buck tops (-52.2).

rev3: F15 = ISO 7380 M3x8 on a stack of 2 x DIN 125 M3 + DIN 9021 M3 (head seat -40.0, tip -48.0): 1.8 of the 2.0 T_most engaged (1.51 at the shortest screw 7.71); a dry-fitted screw whose tip stands proud of the T_most underside gets one more DIN 125 under its head (K7 calibration row). rev3: pan pinion face 3.0 (z -45.9 .. -42.9; a bought 4.0 pinion is shortened by 1.0 at its TOP face): 1.0 under the stage floor.

Tie saddle on the cradle back wall: tunnel 2.2 x 1.2 for a 2.0 mm cable tie (spec 2.8 x 1.2 for 2.5 mm): bars 1.2 and 0.7 above the carrier top within the 4.6 between the carrier (-53.5) and the deck seat (-48.2).  Column-web saddles dropped (see TIE_SADDLES).

Spigot notches / tower keep-out = OBAL F1 zone + 0.5 (x +-(25.1..32.9), |y| >= 15.1, z -81..-74.5): the rev. 1 T_stred boss webs reach beyond a r 3.9 cylinder (0.8 mm collision on the real meshes); stop post 1 loses its y > 15.1 part below -74.5.

Z_naboj_test stop block top -99.3 (rev. 1 -98.3): the lug's R1 root fillets (z -99..-98) must not touch it; the base round's stop block needs the same (top -99.3 .. -100, r 17..21).
